statements.impact_statement: The CPU gateway replaces Debian zlib 1.3.1 with official upstream zlib 1.4, packaged as 1:1.4-0videoq1. Source SHA-256 02dd159783677a749c04adbdd02b55b8a2bcc7e054f51b76b549199a916ad584 matches zlib.net. Debian identifies upstream commit df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148, included in 1.4, as fixing this CVE and CVE-2026-85091. The build requires upstream make check and a caller-buffer lifetime regression after gzwrite failure; that regression crashes the original 1.3.1 library and passes with 1.4 on ARM64. verify_zlib.py checks the actual loaded library, package/source records and zlib/gzip/ZIP round trips in the final distroless image. Debian trixie has not recorded a fixed distribution version; this assessment covers only this source-built package and CVE.

The actually loaded CPU library is checksum-pinned upstream zlib 1.4, packaged as 1:1.4-0videoq1. Upstream commit df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148 resets the retained input buffer on gzwrite failure and is included in 1.4. Debian confirms this fix at https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-85091. build-zlib.sh requires make check and the caller-buffer write-failure/retry regression; verify_zlib.py checks the loaded version and packaged source identity. Distribution metadata has no trixie fixed version; only these exact amd64/arm64 source-built packages are covered.
